summary: Thread-persistence test, signed out, across 7 chambers: Jasmine /clarity, Claude /mirror-archive/chamber, Ansel /resonance/chamber, Sophia /spiral, Kalahar /presence/kalahar, Poindexter /presence/poindexter and /playground. Passed in all 7: one message sent and answered, no /session/<id>/end fired during about 45s of staying, the nav-home-btn departure fired /end, Jasmine's IdentityBadge rename kept the messages with no new /clarity/start, and Kalahar's identity change from another tab (StorageEvent plus sanctuary-identity-change) kept the messages with no extra /start. FAILED in all 7 (CRITICAL, this is David's core requirement): a page reload ENDS the thread. After the reload, /start correctly resumes the same session_id (resumed=true, 3 messages), but LastRoomKeeper then redirects to '/'. That unmounts the chamber, isLeaving() sees pathname '/' != mountPath, and POST /session/<sameId>/end fires. Going back into the chamber then creates a NEW session with no earlier messages.

integration_issues.issue: The reload-redirect in App.js LastRoomKeeper counts as a departure. Sequence seen on every chamber: POST <chamber>/start (resumed=true, same sid) -> navigate('/') -> POST <chamber>/session/<sid>/end. Going back in gives a brand-new session and the earlier messages are gone. This breaks 'reload must bring back the SAME thread'.

/mirror/start is called TWICE on every entry, so 2 sessions are created (e.g. 608bb984 and 37fea27e; 2421a09f and 2b70ac1e on re-entry). The first is orphaned and never ended. Likely cause: the identityReady effect at MirrorArchive.jsx ~58-72 runs twice, or the component remounts; there is no in-flight/opened guard like PresenceChamber's threadOpenedRef.

rca of the issue: On a full reload React mounts the chamber route for the reloaded URL first. Child effects run before LastRoomKeeper's effect, and the chamber's start effect fires /start and resumes the thread. LastRoomKeeper then calls navigate('/', {replace:true}). The chamber unmounts, and its cleanup calls isLeaving(presence, mountPath), which returns true because window.location.pathname is now '/'. So the end beacon fires for the resumed thread. Fix options: (1) Do the redirect BEFORE any route renders: check isRoomPath(window.location.pathname) synchronously at module/App init and call history.replaceState to '/' before ReactDOM render (or render nothing until checked). (2) Or have LastRoomKeeper call markLeaving-style 'suppress' (e.g. a suppressEnd set) for room paths before navigating, so the unmount is not treated as a departure. Option 1 also avoids the wasted /start call. Repro: load '/', pushState to '/clarity', send a message, reload, then watch the POST /clarity/session/<sid>/end right after /clarity/start.
action_items: CRITICAL: stop the reload-redirect (App.js LastRoomKeeper) from ending the thread. Redirect before the chamber routes mount, or suppress the end beacon for that redirect. Then retest all 7 chambers.
Mirror Archive: guard against the duplicate /mirror/start on entry (orphan sessions).

Note: ClarityPod clearIdentity (IdentityBadge 'clear' -> onIdentityChange(null)) still sets messages to [] and sessionId to null. It is explicit, but it wipes the thread on screen without ending it. Decide whether that is acceptable.
critical_code_review_comments: isLeaving() treats any pathname change as a departure, including the app's own programmatic redirect. Programmatic redirects need an opt-out.
PresenceChamber uses sendBeacon while the other chambers use fetch with keepalive. Both work, but this is inconsistent.
MirrorArchive initializeSession has no single-flight guard.

success_rate.frontend: Stay/no-auto-end 7/7, departure end 7/7, identity-change 2/2, reload resume 0/7
